input_messages.content:
Hi! I actually need help with a couple of things. I recently moved to a new house, but it’s still on Elm Avenue here in Houston. I noticed that one of my recent orders was sent to my old address instead of the new one, and I’d like to get that fixed. Also, can you update my default address in your system to the new house? I’d prefer not to share my address again since it should be in my order history. 

And one more thing—I’d like to exchange my tablet for the most affordable model you have, since moving has been a bit expensive. Can you help me with all of this?

Sure! My name is Sophia Martin and my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else to pull up my orders—I’d really prefer not to share my address or zip code if possible, since you should be able to see my recent orders and addresses on file.

Thanks for checking! Actually, I don’t want to share my new address directly—I’d really prefer if you could use the address from my most recent luggage set order, since that was delivered to my new house on Elm Avenue. Can you update both my pending order and my default address to match the address from that luggage order?

Also, just to clarify, I actually want to exchange my current tablet for the cheapest tablet you have, not a more expensive one. Could you let me know what the lowest-priced tablet option is?

Yes, that all sounds perfect! Please go ahead and update both my pending order and my default address to the new address from the luggage order. And yes, I’d like to exchange my current tablet for the cheapest one you mentioned—the 10-inch, 64GB, silver model.

You can use my card ending in 3292 for any price difference. Thanks for handling all of this! Let me know if you need anything else from me.
Yes, please proceed with all of those changes. Thank you so much for your help!

That’s great—thanks for taking care of everything so quickly! I appreciate your help. Have a wonderful day! 

###STOP###
